t: Williams Defender arcade game - instructional video - Red ROMS, factory settings

q.x: Williams "DEFENDER" runs on a 6809 at 1Mhz, no blitter, no tiles, just a straight up bitmapped display. Here's a tutorial video with an expert player and a new gamer being introduced to the game.
